newsitem.title: HONG KONG: GZI Transport says IPO 529 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: GZI Transport says IPO 529 times subscribed.

text.p: GZI Transport Ltd, the infrastructural spinoff of Guangzhou Investment Co Ltd, said on Monday its initial public offer (IPO) had been 529 times subscribed.
GZI Transport issued 250 million new shares at HK$3.23 per share, with warrants on the basis of one warrant for every five shares.

In a statement, GZI Transport said Peregrine Capital Ltd had exercised its overallotment option in full and that 37.5 million additional shares were issued -- 22.5 million for international placement and 15 million for public offer in Hong Kong.

The additional issue brought the total for international placement to 172.5 million shares and for public offer to 115 million shares after 37.5 million shares were reallocated from the placement to the public offer.
The reallocation was made because applications for the public offer were more than eight times higher than the initial number of shares available, it said.
Of the public offer, 83.75 million shares were available to the general public.
The number of shares set aside for existing shareholders of Guangzhou Investment and employees were unchanged by the additional issue at 25 million and 6.25 million, respectively.
Initially, 187.5 million shares were placed internationally and 62.5 million shares were offered to the public.
Trading in the shares is expected to begin on the Hong Kong stock exchange on January 30, GZI said. Peregrine Capital is the global coordinator, sponsor and lead manager of the share offer.
